acip: DE'I PHYIR KENG RUS MED KYANG DE GSAL BAR SNANG BA NI, GZUGS BRNYAN DANG 'DRA BAR GZUGS CAN DU 'DOD DGOS LA, 'DI YID SHES KHO NA LA SNANG BA YIN PAS, GZUGS BRNYAN BZHIN DU GZUGS KYI SKYE MCHED MIN LA, SKYE MCHED GZUGS CAN LHAG MA DGU YANG MIN PAS CHOS KYI SKYE MCHED KYI GZUGS KUN BRTAGS PA ZHES 'BYUNG BA'O,,
english: As such, even though the skeletons don't really exist, we do have to accept that the vivid aspect of them does exist; and that it involves form, in the same way that a reflection in the mirror does. And so despite the fact that the image of the skeletons is not, like the reflection in a mirror, something possessed of form, neither does it belong to any of the remaining nine doors of sense of form. And this means that it constitutes form within the sense door of all things, and can be referred to as an imaginary form.
